title: Rav Yosef Tzidoni
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Ketubot 46a mentions Rav Yosef Tzidoni reciting a baraita of Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai. Yuchasin places him in Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak’s time because the passage says, “Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said, and Rav Yosef Tzidoni likewise recited.” Hyman says Seder HaDorot erred on this point; see Rabbi Yose Tzaydenaya.

notes.text: ארנב״י expands to Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said; it is not a name Arnabi. Hyman glosses bei as a baraita of Shimon ben Yochai. The chronological argument and criticism of Seder HaDorot remain his.

The consulted Ketubot 46a supplies the reciter and reporting formula. The exact Yuchasin and Seder HaDorot discussions were not independently inspected here, and the historical inference remains Hyman’s.
